Bill.BriefDescription: Repealing the deduction for handling losses of motor vehicle fuel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to repealing the deduction for handling losses ofmotor vehicle fuel; repealing RCW 82.36.029 and 82.38.083; andproviding an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The following acts or parts of acts are eachrepealed: RCW 82.36.029 (DeductionsHandling lossesReports) and 1998c 176 s 10; and RCW 82.38.083 (DeductionsHandling lossesReports) and 2013c 225 s 205.
